parsed.headline: Denied: K0553 billed for more than 1 unit per 30 days.
parsed.explanation: The claim is denied because it does not meet the following policy requirement: "Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary." The claim was submitted for 2 units within a 30-day period.
parsed.what_to_do: Review the number of units billed and resubmit if appropriate.
